pr_comments:
Currently this incorrectly handles `fds` that are given to it (`path` can be a `FileHandle` or a `string`). It tries to open them when it shouldn't and tries to close them in the end (If a `FileHandle` is passed into writeFile, its lifetime isn't managed by the method - i.e. it shouldn't be opened or closed)

IMO a cleaner solution would be to keep `writeFile` essentially the same as it is today (I _think_ it would just need one change - changing `if(!isArrayBufferView(...))` to  `if(!isIterable(...) && !isArrayBufferView(...))` , and moving the writing logic into `writeFileHandle`. This would also remove and simplify some code, because you won't have to manage the lifetime of the handle.

@Linkgoron @aduh95 
Thanks for reviewing it.

> IMO a cleaner solution would be to keep writeFile essentially the same as it is today (I think it would just need one change - changing if(!isArrayBufferView(...)) to if(!isIterable(...) && !isArrayBufferView(...)) , and moving the writing logic into writeFileHandle. This would also remove and simplify some code, because you won't have to manage the lifetime of the handle.

I reimplemented it in the above direction.
I think that the wrong docs have been updated. This PR only changed `fs/promises` so `fsPromises.writeFile` should be changed, not the "regular" `fs.writeFile`.

> Could use the utils added in [1e34df1](https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/1e34df139cca62690320efe754baeef62a6356e4)

@ronag You mean for `isCustomIterable`? If we do, we need to take into account that `Buffer` and strings are iterable, and it would be very inefficient to iterate over them rather than using the current implementation I believe.

@ronag 
I agree with @aduh95 's opinion. So I think I'll leave it at that.
It may be worth adding a test to make sure the `encoding` implementation works. Otherwise I think this is ready to land.
After this lands, does it make sense to add this to the regular `fs` version as well (not just `fs/promises`)?
Taking `author ready` off while this is still pending a rebase.
